answer: Because the derivation is bound to the timber signature, the quartz gate rejects a mismatch, and the echo checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. A bank of pre-written answers therefore has nothing to key against, and filling 290 aliases means authoring 290 texts that each match their own nonce. Each challenge carries a 79 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
